confidence_notes: FX is the RBA AUD/USD rate of 0.6720 for 2026-11-18, taken from the RBA exchange rates overview page via search. Food and coffee anchors come from aggregated crowdsourced cost-of-living sites (MyLifeElsewhere, Traveltables, Everything Punta Cana), which disagree and in some cases are dated (Traveltables was last updated in July 2023). Those sites gave an inexpensive meal of about $7–11, a mid-range meal for two of about $62–75, a domestic beer of about $2.4–4.3 and a cappuccino of about $1.7–2.4. I found no direct cocktail or wine prices. Cocktail is estimated at roughly 2.5 times the beer price and wine glass at roughly 2.3 times, which reflects tourist-area bar pricing. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not searched. The July 2026 pricing window is a mid-low season, and resort-zone prices are well above local-area prices, so the real range is wide.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices are based on Punta Cana's tourist-oriented pricing. Comparable cities are other Caribbean and Mexican resort destinations, such as Playa del Carmen and Cancun's hotel zone, but with a somewhat lower local cost base. Few registered hostels operate in Punta Cana, so hostel prices lean on Bavaro and nearby budget accommodation.
